en.role: political party; platform for the State Duma election
en.quote: By 2008, Russia’s minimum wage will reach the subsistence minimum.
en.head: The minimum wage reached the subsistence level only in 2018.
en.body: The federal minimum wage was set at the subsistence level for working-age people on May 1, 2018, at 11,163 rubles. The party programme had promised this by 2008.
